g.title: j1093450157
g.text: Hey... Amir? Can we talk? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]

g.title: j3319261600
g.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it before it goes too far.

g.title: j1201265771
g.text: I know it's not something we've discussed before. It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.

g.title: j4235425316
g.text: I know this might seem strange - but it doesn't mean I feel for you any less.

g.title: j3576421535
g.text: Well, it's not the guitar, at least...? Look, I know this might seem strange - but it doesn't mean I feel for you any less.

g.title: j2071400854
g.text: AaaaaAAAANDDDD we're back. sorry what were you trying to tell me?

g.title: j1588517459
g.text: you... have another SO somewhere? or... somewhen? it's... not one of the hex... right? ....... aaaaguughhh that would be sooo weiiiird

g.title: j3747427016
g.text: it'd be like if you were dating my cousin layla grossgrossgrossgrossgrossgrossgross

g.title: j3031067833
g.text: No, it's not one of the Hex. Or the guitar. Or your cousin.

g.title: j3229863170
g.text: I didn't know you had a cousin.

g.title: j878313729
g.text: OK SO WHAT LIKE WHAT YOU HAVE ANOTHER RELATIONSHIP?!?!?!

g.title: j2230230709
g.text: yeah i guess we never really talk about my family much WE HAVE SO MUCH OTHER SHIT TO TALK ABOUT LIKE WHAT YOU HAVE ANOTHER RELATIONSHIP?!?!?!

g.title: j252139216
g.text: I understand if you're not comfortable with that. And I want you to understand it doesn't mean that YOU mean any less to me.

g.title: j3939314730
g.text: They're not from here, and I don't even know if or how I'd be able to introduce you, but... they're important to me, too. But so are you.

g.title: j2068613882
g.text: I just know it might be hard to grapple with, and if you're not okay with this, I fully accept that. I just didn't want you to think I was lying to you, or hiding something.

g.title: j1233705598
g.text: (thats the sound of me shorting out btw)

g.title: j1086521112
g.text: you mean a lot to me. like, a lot a lot. and I don't want to lose that. and if they're that important to you, then... they're important to me, too.

g.title: j3862669438
g.text: guess i'm just jelly now that I don't get to meet them loool why do you get to have all the fun? stupid being stuck in 1999

g.title: j1868788972
g.text: but in all seriousness? i... really do trust you, though. you are so important to me and i'm glad you told me the truth. i think if you were lying to me about this it'd be very different, y'know?

g.title: j3403702106
g.text: but in all seriousness? i... i'm okay seeing where this goes. i'll trust you. i'm glad you told me the truth. i think if you were lying to me about this, it'd be very different, y'know?

g.title: j2483640149
g.text: so thanks. and... yeah, i'm good with this. as long as everybody's good with it.
